model.name: Qwen3.5-9B (instruct, Apache-2.0)
model.why_this_file: its embedded chat template equals Qwen's official template byte for byte (checked 2026-11-03 via the Hub's GGUF metadata); unsloth's GGUF alters the thinking switch

valid.rationale: Best feasible runs (x6z-xtea-001, aes_cipher) use RC_MODEL 'orfs' or 'cap213' with low density_delta (7-18) and moderate FP_CORE_UTIL (23-27). High density_delta (25) in x6z-xtea-001 correlates with high cell count (429) and high wirelength. To improve T_eff, pin RC_MODEL to 'orfs' (proven robust), reduce density_delta to 10 (lower congestion), and set FP_CORE_UTIL to 25 (balance density and repair). Keep SYNTH_STRATEGY 'AREA 3' (smaller area helps density) and enable SYNTH_SIZING. Disable aggressive repair margins (PL_RESIZER_SETUP_SLACK_MARGIN 0.1, GRT_RESIZER_SETUP_SLACK_MARGIN 0.1) to allow tighter optimization without violating constraints.
